profiles.name: Philip Masonovich
profiles.notes: Downloaded and visually inspected the International Socialist Review September 1916 composite reproduced by We Never Forget. Its visible caption explicitly identifies clockwise from top left: Mr. Masonovich, Gavolivo Orlandich, Jovo Hercigonovich, Jovo Nickich; Mrs. Masonovich in center. Philip is therefore top left in THIS composite. Do not apply the left-to-right order of the separate five-person photograph from Flames of Discontent to this composite. The downloaded composite is approximately 280 by 535 pixels including caption; Philip's available portrait is approximately 130 by 220, inadequate for a clean standard portrait. No enlargement deployed. Seek a higher-resolution original September 1916 ISR scan. The historical article independently names Philip, age 35, as a Biwabik defendant sentenced in December 1916. MNHS shop direct access returned a JavaScript connection-verification challenge. Prior wife-only portrait remains rejected.
profiles.credit: International Socialist Review, September 1916; digital reproduction hosted by We Never Forget; original photographer not established.
profiles.rights: Publication date supports a pre-1930 US publication lead; exact original scan and provenance still to be recorded before ingestion.
